{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/marvels-new-star-wars-series-to-explore-the-new-republic-era|text=Marvel's New Star Wars Series to Explore the New Republic Erae|author=Schedeen, Jessie|date=2025-01-21|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|''IGN'']]|archivedate=20250121171444}} states that the events of [[Star Wars (2025)|''Star Wars'' (2025)]] begin around two [[Standard year|years]] after the events of {{Film|VI}}, which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]]. {{#switch:{{{1|}}}|Past is Prologue=Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars'' must take place around [[6 ABY]]. As "[[Past is Prologue]]"{{#if: {{{2|}}}|, including {{{2}}},|}} takes place immediately before the events of ''Star Wars'', its events must also be set around 6 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].|Therefore, the events of {{#if: {{{1|}}}|[[Star Wars (2025) {{{1}}}|''Star Wars'' (2025) {{{1}}}]]|''Star Wars''}}{{#if: {{{2|}}}|, including {{{2}}},|}} must take place around [[6 ABY]].}}<noinclude>[[Category:Canon dating citation templates]]
